en: Om. Here begins the Vishnu Sahasranama, the hymn of a thousand names of Vishnu, which gives every kind of good fortune.
To remove all obstacles, one should meditate on Vishnu, who wears white clothes, has the colour of the moon, has four arms and a calm, smiling face.
I take refuge in Vishvaksena, whose hundreds of attendants, led by the elephant-faced one, always destroy every obstacle.
I bow to Vyasa, the great-grandson of Vasishtha, the grandson of Shakti, the son of Parashara and the father of Shuka; he is free of all fault and a treasure of austerity.
Salutation to Vyasa, who is a form of Vishnu, and to Vishnu, who is a form of Vyasa. Again and again I bow to him, the descendant of Vasishtha, the treasure-house of sacred knowledge.
Salutation to Vishnu, who never changes, who is pure and eternal, the Supreme Self, always of one single nature, the one who conquers all.
Salutation to Vishnu, the mighty one, by simply remembering whom a person is set free from the bondage of birth and worldly life.
Om. Salutation to Vishnu, the mighty one.
Vaishampayana said: After hearing about all the duties and all the purifying teachings in full, Yudhishthira again spoke to Bhishma, the son of Shantanu.

first: किमेकं दैवतं लोके किं वाप्येकं परायणम्।
en: Yudhishthira said: Who is the one God in the world? What is the one highest goal? By praising whom and by worshipping whom do people reach what is good?

first: को धर्मः सर्वधर्माणां भवतः परमो मतः।
en: Which duty do you think is the highest of all duties? By repeating what is a living being set free from the bondage of birth and worldly life?
Bhishma said: A person who is always ready and praises with a thousand names the Lord of the world, the God of gods, the endless one, the Supreme Person,
and who, with devotion, always worships that same undying Person, meditating on him, praising him, bowing to him and offering sacrifice to him,
who daily praises Vishnu, who has no beginning and no end, the great Lord of all worlds and the overseer of the worlds, goes beyond all sorrow.
He is devoted to the holy, knows all duties, increases the fame of the worlds, is the Lord of the worlds, the great Being, and the source from which all beings arise.
In my view, the highest of all duties is this: that a person should always worship the lotus-eyed Lord with devotion and with hymns of praise.

first: परमं यो महत्तेजः परमं यो महत्तपः।
en: He is the highest great light, the highest great austerity, the highest great Brahman, and the highest refuge.

first: पवित्राणां पवित्रं यो मङ्गलानां च मङ्गलम्।
en: He is the purest of all pure things, the most auspicious of all auspicious things, the God of the gods, and the undying father of all beings.
From him all beings come into being at the start of the first age, and into him they dissolve again when the age ends.
O King, hear from me the thousand names of Vishnu, the chief of the worlds and Lord of the universe, which remove sin and fear.
For the good of all, I will tell you the famous names of the great one which describe his qualities and which the sages have sung.
The seer of these thousand names is the great sage Vedavyasa; the metre is Anushtup; and the deity is Lord Krishna, the son of Devaki.
The seed is 'Amritamshudbhava', the power is 'the delight of Devaki', and the heart is 'Trisama'. It is used for bringing peace.
I bow to the Supreme Person: Vishnu, the victorious one, the great Vishnu, the mighty one, the great Lord, who destroyed demons of many forms.
